name: Bandit Random Pooler
description: Generates binary reward sequences for multi-armed bandit tasks. Creates sequences based on underlying probability distributions with optional drift dynamics.

bandit_random_pool.name: num_rewards
bandit_random_pool.description: Dimension of each sequence element (number of arms in the bandit task).

bandit_random_pool.name: sequence_length
bandit_random_pool.description: Length of each reward sequence (number of trials).

bandit_random_pool.name: initial_probabilities
bandit_random_pool.description: Starting probability values for each arm. Can be fixed values or ranges for sampling.

bandit_random_pool.name: sigmas
bandit_random_pool.description: Drift rates per step for probability dynamics. Can be fixed values or ranges.

bandit_random_pool.name: num_samples
bandit_random_pool.description: Number of experimental conditions (reward sequences) to generate.

outputDataType.name: conditions
outputDataType.description: Generated binary reward sequences for bandit tasks.
